Everyone there wants to text forever, get to know each other, and talk life plans." He laughed: "Means you were on the wrong sites. Here's a link <LINK>. Young girls on there often look for older guys specifically for casual meetups, no strings, no serious stuff." Didn't even take an hour before a twenty-year-old college junior messaged me. Looked stunning in her photos - long hair, athletic build, confident smile. Message was short: "Hey. Been wanting to meet an older, more experienced guy. You free tonight?" I made up a story at home about an urgent work call and headed over.

By morning we finally wore ourselves out, and she lay next to me looking satisfied, smiling like that was exactly the night she'd been waiting for. 😏

Now we see each other 2-3 times a week. Wife has no idea, and I feel alive again. Feels like I'm 30 all over again. 🔥
